load_perplexity_metric: load the perplexity metric from Hugging Face evaluate library for text evaluation
launch_gradio_widget: launch a gradio widget interface for the perplexity metric evaluation
run_perplexity_evaluation: run perplexity evaluation on a given text dataset using the loaded metric module
compute_perplexity_score: compute perplexity scores for input text to measure language model quality
integrate_perplexity_metric: integrate the perplexity metric into a hugging face evaluate pipeline for NLP tasks
